description: Aza’raan: Latin-key appearances; Khmer-only encoded bases and all 28 core sound/structural marks. The 96 additional variant mappings remain the original keyboard assignments.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Acute
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Raise/front the sound; A gives /eɪ/, K can give /kiː/.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Grave
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Lower/back the base sound; W gives /wɑ/, G can become /ɣ/.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Circumflex
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Open or broaden the vowel into a diphthong; A gives Aw /ɑu̯/.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Caron
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Make a compound or affricated articulation; D can be /dz/, T /tʃ/.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Macron
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Lengthen the vowel; A has the Ah /ɑː/ reading.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Breve
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Shorten or reduce duration and vowel quality.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Diaeresis
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Add or separate a rounded/gliding segment.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Tilde
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Nasalize the sound; N acquires /ŋ/ through its merged family.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Ogonek
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Select or add an Eh-quality /ɛ/ to the reading.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Cedilla
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Palatalize or soften consonants: S /ʃ/, J /ʒ/, N /ɲ/.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Dot above
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Voice or brighten a family articulation; B becomes /v/.

coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.name: Stroke overlay
coreLatinAppearancesKhmerEncoding.meaning: Harden or devoice the articulation; B /f/, T /θ/. The Unicode is a Khmer coeng subscript pair.

reservedKhmerMarks.name: AA
reservedKhmerMarks.meaning: Set the vowel nucleus to /ɑː/ (ah), particularly consonant + AH.

reservedKhmerMarks.name: UA
reservedKhmerMarks.meaning: Select /wɑ/ glide-vowel. W + WAH gives /wɑ/ without repeating /w/.

reservedKhmerMarks.name: AE
reservedKhmerMarks.meaning: Set vowel nucleus to /æ/ (a in apple).

reservedKhmerMarks.name: OO
reservedKhmerMarks.meaning: One two-sided Khmer vowel sign. In Aza’raan, its left visual component denotes /æ/ and right /z/. T + sign → /tæz/.

reservedKhmerMarks.name: NIKAHIT
reservedKhmerMarks.meaning: Add final /m/ after a vowel; differs from general nasalization.

reservedKhmerMarks.name: REAHMUK
reservedKhmerMarks.meaning: Add a breathy /h/ ending or aspirated /ʰ/ consonant release.

reservedKhmerMarks.name: BANTOC
reservedKhmerMarks.meaning: Force the usual/standard sound of the base, e.g. N /n/. Adds no phoneme.

specialKhmerMarkers.name: Glottal stop
specialKhmerMarkers.meaning: Add /ʔ/ within the current logical letter, typically before its vowel.

specialKhmerMarkers.name: Click
specialKhmerMarkers.meaning: Add click articulation /ǃ/ to the current logical letter.

specialKhmerMarkers.name: Previous syllable
specialKhmerMarkers.meaning: Emphasize the preceding syllable; no independent phoneme.

specialKhmerMarkers.name: Next syllable
specialKhmerMarkers.meaning: Emphasize the following syllable; no independent phoneme.

tokenRule: One semantic base plus 0 or more modifiers = one Aza’raan letter. Some mixed Khmer vowel-sign stacks are non-standard for ordinary Khmer rendering. Source Unicode letters are never Latin in serialized keyboard output.
